envelope.description: Show the saved comments of a document

body.title: Show the saved comments of a document
body.summary: Saved entries with an anchor are placed on their quotes with a mark and a margin marker that shows the count; clicking either opens the thread, oldest first, with author, time and decision. Entries with no place, and entries without an anchor, are listed in the whole-document strip in time order, tagged when they are from an earlier revision. A document not awaiting review shows its history and offers send feedback only.
acceptanceChecks: Saved inline entries appear on their passages with a count and open oldest first
An entry whose quote is gone is listed as on an earlier revision with its quote; entries without an anchor are listed in time order
An entry the shell cannot read is skipped and counted
A document not awaiting review shows its history and offers send feedback only
Author, comment and quote text are set as text
